caption: The drawing features a central, color rendering of a hand-operated bellows, which appears to be made of dark brown wood with metallic components and some blue and orange detailing, especially near the tapered nozzle at the bottom. The bellows has two handles at the top, with the main body showing a layered construction fastened by rivets. Surrounding the central colored drawing are four pencil sketches of the same object, placed in each corner of the rectangular page. The sketches show different views and sections of the bellows: the upper left depicts a side view with both handles visible, the upper right and lower right display partial or sectional views of the nozzle area, and the lower left shows the bellows from the rear, emphasizing the round hole in the handle. The background is a plain, light tan color, and the borderlines of each sketch are lightly marked.
title: Bellows
